prompt:
A sprite sheet of 6 separate objects for a top-down JRPG map, to be placed on top of the painted map shown in the reference image. Match the reference exactly: the same hi-bit pixel-painting style and brushwork, the same palette and material textures, the same soft light from the upper left (lit tops and left sides, shaded right sides), the same classic steep 3/4 top-down view (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 2 x 3 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom) with wide empty space between them; every object fully separate, nothing touching, nothing cut off. Draw each object large, filling most of its grid cell. The objects, in order: 1) small forest lantern: a paper-and-wood lantern on a short wooden stake (unlit); 2) small cluster of pale teal glowing mushrooms; 3) rustic notice board made of rough planks and branches with pinned leaves of paper; 4) rustic wooden signpost made of a branch with a blank plank; 5) small forest market stall with a green leaf-patterned cloth awning and baskets; 6) clump of tall reeds.
Background: fully transparent. No ground, no floor, no shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers. Even albedo lighting: no night, no glow halos and no light spilling around the objects (lamps unlit).
revised_prompt: Generate a single sprite sheet using the user-provided forest JRPG map image as the exact STYLE REFERENCE (not as the background). Canvas fully transparent alpha, with six completely isolated pixel-painted objects in a 2-column x 3-row grid, reading order, generous transparent gaps; objects large and fully within individual cells. Match reference's detailed hi-bit pixel-paint brushwork, natural muted forest greens, teal blues, warm brown timber, cream paper, irregular pixel-textured edges, steep classic 3/4 overhead game-map projection, soft light upper left on tops and left faces, subtle shade on right faces. Row 1 left: small unlit forest lantern, cream paper panels framed in brown timber, short wooden stake; right: compact group of pale teal mushroom caps with gently luminous-looking coloration but absolutely no glow halo or light spill. Row 2 left: rustic rough-plank and branch notice board with a few small pinned blank cream paper leaves (no writing); right: branch-post rustic signpost bearing a blank horizontal wood plank. Row 3 left: small woodland market stall, green leaf-patterned cloth awning above wood frame and several baskets; right: clump of tall slender green marsh reeds. Show each upright object's top and forward face with its base at bottom. NO scenery, NO ground, NO floor, NO cast shadows, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers, NO outlines around sprites or grid, NO extra props, lantern unlit. Transparent background everywhere between and around silhouettes.
